proposal.rationale:
Addition to the planning envelope, prioritizing research: projected overruns (research 25000.00, engineering 5000.00) are covered first, research first; the remaining buffer is split half to research and half across other teams with a projected overrun. Context (research, current): Approved research plan (2026-10-08) expands model-evaluation work in the current planning period; larger evaluation sweeps start this period instead of next. Evidence: "This plan expands model-evaluation work during the current planning period." (research-eval-plan v1); "This plan supersedes the earlier email thread that proposed pushing the expansion to next period." (research-eval-plan v1). Context (product, current): Product launch update (2026-10-14) moves the GA milestone to the following period, reducing near-term launch rehearsal compared with the August plan (which had launch this period). Evidence: "The general-availability launch milestone for the assistant workspace lands in the current period." (product-launch-plan v1); "The general-availability launch milestone moves to the following period after customer pilot
feedback." (product-launch-plan v2). Context (engineering, current): Engineering platform migration continues through the current period at the current pace; seats stay flat. Evidence: "Platform migration work continues through the current period at the current pace." (engineering-platform-note v1). Not relied on: Older research email thread (2026-09-03) said the model-evaluation expansion would be pushed to next period; this timeline is no longer the current plan. (superseded). Projections are simulated (shared placeholder (not a forecast model)), not measured spend. Drafted by Droid for finance review; nothing is applied until a finance approver decides.
